chapterTitle: The Ordinary-Extraordinary Strategy: Take the Line of Least Expectation
coreMove: Break the opponent's forecast by varying the texture of the move while keeping the underlying objective stable.
reversal: Variation becomes self-sabotage when the operator mistakes randomness or theater for strategy and loses internal coherence.
teachingEmphasis: show why the ordinary move can be strongest when spectacle is expected
keep the operator's objective stable underneath outward variation
avoid romanticizing surprise for its own sake
